final: WITH invoice_metrics AS (SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_product_cost) AS avg_product_cost, SUM(derived_total_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(product_price), 0) AS ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM invoice_metrics) SELECT AVG(im.avg_product_cost) AS average_product_cost, AVG(im.ratio) AS average_ratio, AVG(im.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS average_ratio_above_overall FROM invoice_metrics AS im CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE im.ratio > o.avg_ratio
